label: World Bank Indicators API
terms_note: Open data (CC BY 4.0), no key. HTML docs (helpdesk articles). The API answers XML unless format=json is sent; it ignores the Accept header (live 2026-10-01). JSON answers are a two-element array [paging metadata, rows]. Errors are HTTP 200 [{"message":[{"id":"120","key":"Invalid value","value":"The provided parameter value is not valid"}]}] - for an unknown indicator or country and for a half-open date range such as 2020: (both ends are needed).

get_series.note: series_id is '<country>/<indicator>': an ISO3 or ISO2 country (or region/aggregate code such as WLD, EUU) and an indicator code, e.g. 'USA/NY.GDP.MKTP.CD' (GDP, current US$), 'BRA/FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG' (inflation). Annual points, newest first, value null where missing. A date window is sent only when both start and end are given (the years are used).

not_offered.search_symbols: The API lists indicators (/v2/indicator, ~29,000, paged) but has no search parameter; mapping `query` would fake a search.
